name: Six Senses Fiji
insider_take: This exclusive resort sits on pristine Malolo Island in the Mamanuca archipelago, where traditional Fijian culture meets ultra-luxury wellness in one of the world's most remote paradises.
whats_special: Six Senses Fiji is the only resort on 22-acre Malolo Island, featuring 24 clifftop and beachfront villas with private pools. The property boasts Fiji's first overwater spa treatment rooms and grows its own organic produce in on-site gardens. Each villa comes with a dedicated Bose butler (personal assistant) trained in traditional Fijian hospitality.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Ocean Pool Villa for unobstructed views of the famous Fijian sunset, and time your visit during turtle nesting season (November-January) when hawksbill turtles nest right on the resort's beach.
dont_miss: The signature spa treatment in the overwater pavilions, snorkeling at the house reef teeming with tropical fish, and the traditional kava ceremony at sunset. The resort's organic garden tour and cooking classes showcase ingredients grown on-island, while the nearby Cloud 9 floating bar offers a unique day trip experience.
pros: Stunning overwater and beachfront villas with panoramic ocean views
World-class Six Senses Spa with holistic wellness treatments
Exceptional sustainability practices and eco-conscious luxury design
Pristine private beach access on Malolo Island
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane or boat transfer
